title: [Financial Reports] Trial Balance by Period (Excel) should use a query-based approach rather than loop and CalcFields
summary: Trial Balance by Period (Excel) report now uses a query-based approach instead of looping with CalcFields, reducing SQL calls from hundreds of thousands to just two per account and period, enabling completion within reasonable timeframes.
key_points: Replaced inefficient loop-and-CalcFields pattern with a single query that groups G/L entries by dimension values
Reduces SQL calls from approximately 4 × accounts × periods × (1 + D1 + D2 + D1·D2) to just 2 × accounts × periods
Query runs twice per account per period: once for net change and once for balance
Dimension values loaded once in OnPreReport instead of repeatedly queried
Dataset generation moved from database to memory buffer, maintaining same output format with and without zero-value filtering
